violations.description: Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -Soda, ice cream and coffee dispensers need cleaned.

Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Warewash machine was not maintained and/or operated as required. -D/W needs cleaned.--Wash water for mechanical warewash machine was not maintained at proper temperature. -Wash and rinse temperature only reached 70F and 102F respectively.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floors throughout facility need further cleaning.
Storage and handling of maintenance items. — --Wet-use maintenance items, such as mops, were not placed in a position that allows proper air-drying. -2 mops sitting in mop sink.
Mechanical cleaning and sanitizing requirements. — --Wash water for mechanical warewash machine was not maintained at proper temperature. -Water temp did not reach 120F.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…)were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. -Floors in kitchen need more thorough cleaning.
Clean, proper temperature, cleaning agent (2 pts deducted)
Design, construction, clean, maintained (1 pt deducted)
Design, installation, clean, and maintained (1 pt deducted)
